notes: **Item F2: the Fig. 2 and Fig. 3 captions**, checked against the images (`08_USED_creating_figures/Figure_2/Fig2.png`, `Figure_3/Fig3.png`). Both are correct: the panels, labels, statistics and group sizes all match. The changes are small.

**Fig. 2:** the locus-coloring clause is trimmed. The threshold now gives α = 0.10 (the rule, not only the value). One clause says what the red line in the QQ plots is (the expectation under the null), which was not explained.

**Fig. 3:**
> - The title said "the haplotypes of five elite malting cultivars". The cultivars were not assigned haplotypes (M&M: "they were not included in the haplotype analysis or assigned to haplotype groups"); panels d–f show their **genotypes**. It now reads "…and the genotypes of five elite malting cultivars at these genes".
> - Panels a–c now lead with the short gene names, as the panel titles in the figure and the text do: "*GPAT6* (*HORVU.MOREX.r3.3HG0301300*), fiber".
> - The rest is unchanged.
**For later (Fig. 4, not in this item):** its title has the same "the haplotypes of five elite malting cultivars" wording. I will fix it the same way in R4 (Ch. 4 + Fig. 4) unless you say otherwise.
